text:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing/metering elevated. Token-count drift detected for prod-east. Overflag threshold breached for several customers, automated overage emails queued. Investigate. :rotating_light:

dan: seeing the same in dashboards — token delta +18% over 10m. Query: token_emitter -> proxy rewrite deployed ~8:45 UTC?
maria: yep, deploy by kevin at 08:44 UTC. I'm on call, taking triage.
kevin: flagged the proxy rewrite earlier but low-risk. rolling back now: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/proxy-gateway -n prod --to-revision=3`
sara: billing-ops: customers A and C already received overage flags, CS pinged. Can we suppress auto-emails while we sort?
liz: CS here — hold on outgoing emails pls. I've put a hold on the automated notification queue in Intercom (manual toggle). Customers are asking.
maria: rollback initiated. watching token emission metrics + logs.
kevin: rollback finished, proxy pods restarted. health checks green.
dan: logs show duplicate upstream ack in a 200ms window. snippet:
```
[2025-06-15T08:45:10Z] emitter_id=abc123 tokens=512 request_id=xyz ack_received=true
[2025-06-15T08:45:10Z] emitter_id=abc123 tokens=512 request_id=xyz duplicate_ack=true
```
looks like proxy replaying same request once.
maria: disabling proxy request-retry middleware as hotfix. `env PROXY_RETRY=off` applied to deployment.
sara: billing-ops — can you pause the overflag pipeline (shadow aggregator) so we stop escalating?
sara: pausing now: `POST /internal/billing/flags/pause` -> 202 Accepted.
kevin: quick root cause note: the rewrite changed upstream ID header normalization which prevented idempotency key from being passed through, so retries weren't deduped downstream.
maria: confirm emitter stream has returned to baseline after rollback. delta down to +1.5% over 5m.
dan: good. what about delayed usage reports? I see a backlog in the usage-ingest topic (~120s lag). Might be related.
kevin: consumer lag spiked when we restarted proxy pods; consumers are catching up. Offsets: `kafka-consumer-group --describe usage-ingest` shows lag=430 -> now decaying.
sara: billing-ops will run reconciliation once backlog clears. ETA 30m for accurate daily counts.
liz: prepping customer comms: short note that we saw transient miscounting and paused billing alerts while we validated. Will send after reconcile.
maria: assigning follow-ups: kevin to PR to ensure idempotency header preserved, sara to reconcile counts/reverse false overage flags, dan to create postmortem stub. I'm handing off - oncall shift ending in 20m, dan you're on next.
dan: taking over. I'll be primary until resolved.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity -> medium; impacted customers flagged: list attached to incident ticket.
sara: billing-ops notes: will run `reconcile_usage --start 2025-06-15T08:30 --end 2025-06-15T09:00 --fix-false-flags` after lag <50.
kevin: created PR #1423 with idempotency header fix + integration test for retry behavior.
maria: ack. put postmortem template at /docs/incidents/1745600000.
liz: CS will hold off outbound emails until sara confirms fixes applied.
dan: monitoring for 15m post-lag. if counts stable we will mark mitigated and schedule billing ledger re-run.
incident-bot: RESOLVE CHECK: mitigation in place, monitoring. Close when reconciliation complete. :white_check_mark:
